scope: Base declarations after bounded local macro expansion. No mounted overrides or live profile/obstacle IDs assumed. The terrain ID table is initialized natively by A44070/8CC950. Profile declaration order feeds the native vector; obstacle source_order is not a verified native ID. Inputs and epsilon use binary32; derived cost models use Python sqrt/division, not bit-exact native powf rounding. Unspecified terrain indices retain native defaults: index0 cost/ratio -1, indices1..15 cost0/ratio1, all permissions true. Radius authored values require the native spatial scale.
